Black Turtleneck & White Socks

Clean, preppy, graphic
WORKING NOTES
- The black and white contrast is the core idea; keep the backdrop plain.
- Add "head to toe" to make sure the flats and socks stay in frame.
Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the flats and socks.
IMAGE PROMPT
A full-body studio fashion portrait of an original
young woman with long, straight black hair parted
in the center, falling past her shoulders, standing
against a plain white seamless backdrop. She
wears a fitted black ribbed knit turtleneck with long
sleeves that end at her wrists, paired with a short
white mini skirt with a relaxed A-line cut. Tall white
ribbed knee-high socks and black pointed-toe flats
with a small bow detail complete the look. Her arms
are relaxed at her sides, and her expression is
calm and direct. Soft, even studio lighting with
minimal shadow, a high-contrast palette of black,
white, and warm skin tones. Clean, preppy, and
graphic, in the style of a minimalist catalog or
school uniform-inspired fashion editorial.
